Remove any remaining clothes, detergent, or water from the machine. This will prevent any potential mess or damage during transportation. ### **Disconnect and Drain the Machine** Disconnect the washing machine from the power source and drain any remaining water from the machine. This is a crucial step to prevent any accidents or water damage. ### **Take Apart the Machine (If Necessary)** If your washing machine is large or heavy, you may need to disassemble it to make it easier to transport.
